text:
Government Ekpemupolo (Tompolo) has intensified grassroots mobilization for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s 2027 re-election bid with the deployment of 52 operational campaign vehicles across Ondo and Gombe states. A statement in Abuja on Tuesday said the Grand Patron of the PBAT Door-to-Door Movement officially presented 26 vehicles each during separate inauguration ceremonies held for local government and ward coordinators in Akure, Ondo State, and Gombe State on Tuesday. Represented by Kestin Pondi, Managing Director of Tantita Security Services Limited, Tompolo charged coordinators to spearhead an aggressive campaign strategy, reaching communities, creeks, religious institutions, and public spaces. Speaking in Akure, Pondi urged Ondo coordinators to act as ambassadors for the administration and translate the state’s registered voters into actual ballots. “We are inaugurating local government and ward coordinators today with 26 vehicles to reach every nook, cranny, and creek to share the PBAT story,” Pondi stated. “The President is doing well. today, fuel queues and ASUU strikes are things of the past, while salaries and pensions are paid regularly. Preach this everywhere and support the President with your votes in 2027.”
Similarly, during the presentation in Gombe, the delegation reaffirmed its commitment to establishing robust state structures to carry the administration’s achievements to the voters.
Receiving the vehicles, Ondo State Governor Lucky Aiyedatiwa and Gombe State Governor Inuwa Yahaya expressed gratitude to Tompolo and the movement for bolstering their state campaign logistics. Both governors declared that the All Progressives Congress (APC) remains united and poised for victory in their respective states.
In Gombe, Governor Yahaya highlighted key federal interventions, noting that the state is currently executing an agricultural development program targeting farmers, herders, and youth, backed by a ₦130 billion grant approved by President Tinubu.
